integrity: The proof is self-contained given the standard effective-resistance trace inverse identity, and exact finite symbolic checks are included; these checks do not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Near-threshold local expansion for joins of a universal hub with a vertex- and edge-transitive simple peripheral graph. The sharp chord-activation price criterion is established by earlier general convex optimality and tree-chord screening; the asserted contribution is the universal conductance and resistance near-critical scaling plus triangle-sensitive correction. Arbitrary subcritical prices and arbitrary nontransitive peripherals are not classified. Bibliographic completeness is not assured.
title: Universal near-activation law for resistance-optimal hub networks
